newsitem.title: hong kong: TENNIS-RAIN HALTS HONG KONG V THAILAND DAVIS CUP TIE.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-RAIN HALTS HONG KONG V THAILAND DAVIS CUP TIE.

text.p: HONG KONG, Feb 15, Reuter - Rain interrupted the doubles match in the Davis Cup Asia-Oceania zone group two first-round tie between Hong Kong and Thailand on Saturday, with Thailand's Thanakorn Srichaphan and Narathorn Srichaphan leading Graeme Foster and Mark Ferreira 6-1 1-0.
Organisers said the game would restart on Sunday. Thailand hold a 2-0 lead after the opening singles on Friday.
